title: 第185章 玄仙境界第184章 金色劫雷
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第185章玄仙境界
如郁凡所料，这金色劫雷真的劈下来的时候，郁凡有种这玩意压根就是想要劈死他的节奏。
他强忍了第一波，身体都被电得如同裂开了来似的，红的白的，看上去十分的恐怖。
额头上溢出一滴滴的汗珠，但郁凡不敢有任何的放松，就像感受不到身体的疼痛似的。
虽然内心不断的跳脚吐槽，但是表面上看上去还是风淡云轻的。
这劫雷的动静太大了，而且还是那些仙兽们从未看到过的金色劫雷，吸引了不少的过来围观。
然而围过来的大多数仙兽并不知道有郁凡的存在。
有些好奇的问着：“这劫雷为何和我们的都不一样呢？”
“可能是因为他是异种生物？”
“是啊，这个仙兽的形态真的很奇怪，他居然是直立的。”
外面热闹分成，里面却安静如鸡。
郁凡也没有什么心思给大家来一场手动抵抗神雷这类的游戏。
他现在所有的精力都用在了渡劫的上面。
在第三道劫雷结束的时候，已经直接被电成了一个乌漆嘛黑的人。
郁凡一张嘴就吐出一口黑烟，撑着自己的身体等待着下一道劫雷的到来。
他察觉到了仙劫与人间界劫雷不一样的点了。
这金色的劫雷虽然打在身上疼痛无比，但每一次落在身上，却隐隐有一股仙力注入自己身体中。
这分明是在雷劫中不断的淬炼自己的身体，让自己能够真正彻底的摆脱肉体凡胎。
所以这雷劫压根就打不死人，也不存在会渡劫失败。
相反的，在这个雷劫结束的时候，这渡劫之人的实力反而会不断的加强。

这仙劫让郁凡真正的感受到了仙界与人界的不同。
都说修仙是逆天而行，那成仙后的修炼分明就是在顺应天道。
所以他完全没有必要去抵抗雷劫，反而是只要躺平任劈就好。
这般想着郁凡就真的忍着疼痛，不断的吸收雷劫给他带来的好处了。
白澈在一旁守着，其他的仙兽感受到那金色的劫雷中带着他们惧怕的力量而不敢随意的靠近。
只敢在远处偷偷的看着。
白澈也松了一口气，还好那雷恐怖无比，至少这样可以震慑住不少家伙。
而那些大家伙们现在似乎也还没有动静。
这般想着，他看了一眼森林的方向。
那只黑色的豹子分明就潜伏在那个方向。
他能够感受到对方的敌意，可是他现在也不敢做点其他的什么。
现在黑色的豹子必然是因为惧怕雷才不敢过来。
若是结束了这雷劫，这豹子必然是会来报仇的。
毕竟他们是真的将这豹子给偷了个精光啊。
郁凡劈着劈着也就麻木了。
最后一道劫雷结束的时候，他的衣服，头发全部都被雷电给烤了个精光。
要不是最后的仙霖的降落将他的身体上的伤痕全部恢复了，他都觉得自己这难看的样子不知道要养多久。
然而就算是有仙霖也救不了他的衣服和头发，眉毛...
郁凡一脸的欲哭无泪。
然而渡完劫，郁凡对于危险的感知也越发的强大了。

他总算是能感受到有人在暗处伺机盯着他。
第185章玄仙境界
郁凡快速的朝着白澈跑过去，并且将白澈一扯。

Chapter 185 The Mysterious Realm
As Yu Fan expected, when the golden thunderbolt really struck down, Yu Fan had the feeling that it wanted to strike him to death.
He endured the first wave, and his body was electrocuted as if it was split open. It was red and white and looked very scary.
Beads of sweat overflowed on his forehead, but Yu Fan didn't dare to relax at all, as if he couldn't feel the pain in his body.
Although he kept jumping up and down in his heart, he still looked calm on the surface.
The movement of this tribulation thunder was too great, and it was a golden tribulation thunder that the immortal beasts had never seen before, attracting many people to come and watch.
However, most of the immortal beasts that came around did not know that Yu Fan existed.
Some curiously asked: "Why is this Tribulation Thunder different from ours?"
"Maybe it's because he is a heterogeneous creature?"
"Yes, the shape of this fairy beast is really strange. He is actually upright."
It was lively outside, but as quiet as a chicken inside.
Yu Fan didn't have any intention to play a game of manually resisting the divine thunder for everyone.
All his energy now is spent on overcoming the tribulation.
When the third thunderbolt ended, he was directly electrocuted into a pitch-black person.
Yu Fan opened his mouth and blew out a mouthful of black smoke, holding his body up and waiting for the next thunderbolt to arrive.
He noticed the difference between the Immortal Tribulation and the Human World Tribulation Thunder.
Although this golden thunderbolt hits the body with great pain, every time it hits the body, a faint fairy power is injected into his body.
This is obviously the continuous tempering of one's body in the thunder tribulation, so that one can truly and completely get rid of the mortal body.
Therefore, this thunder tribulation cannot kill anyone at all, and there is no chance of failure in overcoming the tribulation.
On the contrary, when this thunder tribulation ends, the strength of the person who has overcome the tribulation will continue to strengthen.
This immortal calamity made Yu Fan truly feel the difference between the immortal world and the human world.
It is said that cultivating an immortal is going against heaven, so the cultivation after becoming an immortal is clearly following the way of heaven.
Therefore, there was absolutely no need for him to resist the thunder tribulation. Instead, he could just lie flat and let it be hacked.
Thinking of this, Yu Fan really endured the pain and continued to absorb the benefits brought to him by the thunderstorm.
Bai Che stood guard at the side, while the other immortal beasts felt the power they feared in the golden tribulation thunder and did not dare to approach at will.
I only dared to watch secretly from a distance.
Bai Che also breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, the thunder was extremely terrifying. At least it could scare many guys.
And those big guys don't seem to be moving yet.
With this thought in mind, he glanced in the direction of the forest.
The black leopard was clearly lurking in that direction.
He could feel the other party's hostility, but he didn't dare to do anything else now.
Now the black leopard must be afraid of thunder and dare not come over.
If this thunder disaster is ended, the leopard will definitely come to take revenge.
After all, they really stole all the leopard.
Yu Fan became numb after chopping and chopping.
When the last thunderbolt ended, his clothes and hair were all burned away by the lightning.
If the final Xian Lin hadn't landed and restored all the scars on his body, he would have felt that he would have to stay in this ugly state for who knows how long.
However, even Xianlin couldn't save his clothes, hair, eyebrows...
Yu Fan looked like he was about to cry but had no tears.
However, after surviving the tribulation, Yu Fan's perception of danger became stronger.
He could finally feel someone waiting in the dark to stare at him.
Chapter 185 The Mysterious Realm
Yu Fan quickly ran towards Bai Che and pulled Bai Che away.
